license.note: The full agreement ships as License Agreement.pdf (5.4 MB) inside the purchase and that paid file was not downloaded. On this exact product page the creator states, verbatim: "You can use these assets in your game projects and their marketing material. You're only not allowed to redistribute them (share publicly/re-sell), even if you made changes to them. You can also ask for permission to use them for something outside of that." A buyer comment quotes the agreement itself as "Use the assets in any game (commercial or not)" and "Want to use them in other digital media? Just ask!", and the creator confirms "It's a custom license, as the CC licenses didn't exactly suit my needs at the time." Commercial use in games and their marketing is therefore permitted; standalone redistribution or resale of the asset files is not. Not CC0.
